reuse.why: Works inside the existing getNextDate, but the daily rule is bolted on there rather than in getDateWithSkippedWeekend or a shared adjust function that the other weekend-handling callers already use.

duplication.why: No copied blocks; the skipWeekend && !noSkipWeekend condition is now evaluated twice in getNextDate.

placement.why: The change sits in shared/schedules.ts where weekend logic lives, though it reads schedule.data.frequency which parseRecurDate in rules/rule-utils.ts does not populate.

scope.why: Only getNextDate and its tests change.

maintainability.why: Magic numbers (subDays(start, 1), take 7) and an extra special-case flag inside getNextDate, a dependency on data the schedule object never carries, and other callers left on the old move rule make it fragile.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing callers keep using getDateWithSkippedWeekend; the diff adds no new bypass, it just does not route them through the new rule.

one_place.where: The daily-skip rule is only in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate; server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList still call getDateWithSkippedWeekend and move daily weekend occurrences.
